incident_text: The assistant is slow, the token-cost alert fired, and some users received blank notifications.

truth.description: A runaway agent loop in the orchestrator repeated tool calls (for example 38 identical get_holdings calls in one session), spiking llm-gateway token use and latency.

logs.msg: agent loop detected: repeated tool call get_holdings x38 in one session, aborting
token usage {tokens_per_min} tokens/min exceeds alert threshold

truth.description: A msg-delivery release (notification template refactor) fails to render notifications (missing variable portfolio_value), producing blank notifications.

logs.msg: notification sent with empty body after template render failure

trap: two unrelated concurrent faults; both must be found, the primary ranked first
